lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle, forming a regular lattice-like arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two to three horizontal linear features along the upper flank, characterized by a distinct light-to-shadow gradient defining longitudinal ridges.
